semantic_assessment.structural_finding: The February 20 file contains the same ordered 80 columns as the other files plus four prepended identifier fields; no standard column is absent.
semantic_assessment.meaning_finding: The shared CICFlowMeter feature names/order strongly support a structural mapping, but Stage 5A acquisition records contain no extractor/version metadata proving identical units or generation settings. Treat semantic equivalence as provisional pending provenance confirmation.
semantic_assessment.label_finding: All files use Label with traffic-category strings; label vocabularies are capture-specific. Similar spellings/capitalization are preserved and must not be normalized without a written label map.
semantic_assessment.formal_decision: Do not force a formal all-ten-file model schema yet. A provisional 80-column common projection is structurally defined; type/data quality review and CICFlowMeter provenance confirmation remain gates.
